meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 连接 xAI 账户后,Claude 会用 x_search 工具搜索 X/Twitter 的内容。它按当前日期设置起点、优先限定你信任的账号,把一个大问题拆成按账号/关键词的 2~3 次搜索,并对时间敏感话题加上日期范围。返回时标注每条结果的 x.com 链接和来源,还会和网页搜索的结果互相印证。
howto.when: 当你直接要求搜索 X/Twitter(例如说“查一下 X 上的帖子”“找推文”),或提到想了解 X 上的动态、社交信号时触发;前提是已连接 xAI 账户且 x_search 工具可用。

say.text: 搜一下 X 上关于 NVDA 最新的帖子,只要英文,不要回复。
say.note: 会作为关键词搜索并过滤回复。

say.text: 查查 @growth_papa 这两天在 X 说了什么。
say.note: 限定该账号并应用日期范围。

howto.what_en: When xAI is connected, Claude searches X/Twitter via x_search: date-bounds time-sensitive queries, scopes trusted accounts, splits broad asks into 2–3 narrower searches, labels every result as an X post with its x.com URL, and reconciles with web_search.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search X/Twitter, look for tweets/posts on X, or gauge social signal — as long as an xAI credential is present and x_search is available.

say_en.text: Search X for the latest posts about NVDA, English only, exclude replies.
say_en.note: Runs a keyword pass with reply noise removed.

say_en.text: What has @growth_papa posted on X in the last two days?
say_en.note: Scopes to that account with a date window.

say_en.text: Pull the replies and quotes for this post: https://x.com/example/status/1
say_en.note: Fetches the thread around that post.
